scene_info

Scene Information Data Structure for TurtleBot Soccer Player.

This module defines the SceneInfo dataclass which serves as a structured container for storing information about detected objects in the environment.

Classes

SceneInfo(has_ball, ball_position, int] =, ...)

Data container for scene analysis results from image processing.
